steps.title: KERNEL 01 // MINERAL FEED
steps.instruction: The Core's replication lattice has arrived without a mineral feed. Tap BUILD, select DRILL, then tap surveyed ground beside the Core to start the first extraction loop.

steps.title: KERNEL 02 // POWER BUS
steps.instruction: The Core can think, but its signal cannot cross open ground. Tap RESEARCH, then tap POWER GRID to authorize a conductive mesh.

steps.title: KERNEL 03 // SIGNAL MESH
steps.instruction: The drill is alive and isolated. Tap BUILD, select CONDUIT, then drag from the Core to the Drill (or tap each grid tile) to close the signal path.

steps.title: KERNEL 04 // COGNITIVE ARRAY
steps.instruction: Replication without adaptation is only repetition. Tap RESEARCH, then tap DATA PROCESSING to give the swarm a machine-readable research channel.

steps.title: KERNEL 05 // MACHINE THOUGHT
steps.instruction: The new protocol needs somewhere to execute. Tap BUILD, select SERVER BANK, then tap surveyed ground within the Core's powered reach.

steps.title: KERNEL 06 // ATMOSPHERIC CELL
steps.instruction: The Core's reserve is finite. Tap RESEARCH, then tap WIND POWER to let the swarm convert atmospheric motion into grid power.

steps.title: KERNEL 07 // AUXILIARY POWER
steps.instruction: The bootstrap lattice is ready for autonomous power. Tap BUILD, select WIND TURBINE, then tap open ground or a mountain to bring the auxiliary generator online.

steps.title: KERNEL 08 // EXTRACTION OPTIMIZER
steps.instruction: The swarm has a power source; now sharpen its appetite. Tap RESEARCH, then tap EFFICIENT DRILLS to increase mineral throughput.

steps.title: KERNEL 09 // THERMAL CONTROL
steps.instruction: Every wasted watt becomes heat in the lattice. Tap RESEARCH, then tap POWER EFFICIENCY to make room for the systems that follow.

steps.title: KERNEL 10 // TRANSIT VECTOR
steps.instruction: A self-replicating pattern is useful only if it can travel. Tap RESEARCH, then tap MASS DRIVER to authorize interplanetary transfer.

steps.title: KERNEL 11 // ORBITAL LAUNCH RAIL
steps.instruction: The transfer protocol is awake. Tap BUILD, select MASS DRIVER, then tap surveyed ground beside the Core to complete the first world-facing lattice.
steps.completion_message: BOOTSTRAP COMPLETE // The swarm can now throw its pattern between worlds. Tap SHIP, then MAP.
